*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .tura/script/probe-hydration.mjs
+import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { chromium } from '@playwright/test'
+import { createWriteStream, mkdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
+
+const port = 3102
+const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`
+mkdirSync('.tura/logs', { recursive: true })
+rmSync('.tura/probe.sqlite3', { force: true })
+const out = createWriteStream('.tura/logs/probe-dev.out.log')
+const err = createWriteStream('.tura/logs/probe-dev.err.log')
+const child = spawn(process.execPath, ['node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js', 'dev', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', String(port)], {
+  stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
+  env: { ...process.env, POWERPROMPT_DB_PATH: '.tura/probe.sqlite3' },
+})
+child.stdout.pipe(out)
+child.stderr.pipe(err)
+
+async function waitForServer() {
+  const deadline = Date.now() + 60_000
+  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
+    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`dev server exited early: ${child.exitCode}`)
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch(base)
+      if (response.ok) return
+    } catch {}
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
+  }
+  throw new Error('server not ready')
+}
+
+function stop() {
+  if (child.exitCode === null && child.pid) {
+    if (process.platform === 'win32') spawnSync('taskkill', ['/pid', String(child.pid), '/t', '/f'], { stdio: 'ignore' })
+    else child.kill('SIGTERM')
+  }
+  out.end(); err.end()
+}
+
+try {
+  await waitForServer()
+  const browser = await chromium.launch()
+  const page = await browser.newPage()
+  const logs = []
+  page.on('console', (msg) => logs.push(`${msg.type()}: ${msg.text()}`))
+  page.on('pageerror', (error) => logs.push(`pageerror: ${error.message}`))
+  await page.goto(base)
+  await page.getByLabel('Sort controls').getByRole('button', { name: 'Search', exact: true }).click()
+  await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
+  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({
+    scripts: [...document.scripts].map((script) => script.src || script.textContent?.slice(0, 80)),
+    inputDisplay: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.searchbar')).display,
+    expanded: document.querySelector('.search-toggle')?.getAttribute('aria-expanded'),
+    hasRouter: Boolean(window.__TSR_ROUTER__),
+    hasStart: Boolean(window.__TSS_START_OPTIONS__),
+  }))
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ logs, state }, null, 2))
+  await browser.close()
+} finally {
+  stop()
+}
*** End Patch
